# Screenshelf

> Search your screenshots by the text inside them (on-device OCR) and export to Markdown or Obsidian.

- **Platform**: macOS 14 or later (Apple silicon and Intel)
- **Price**: $24.99 — one-time purchase, no subscription
- **Vendor**: Perfect Paradox Ltd (NI739317), United Kingdom
- **Privacy**: runs on your own machine; no telemetry, no account required

## Links

- [Product page](https://screenshelf.perfectparadox.co.uk/): what it does, features, FAQ and pricing
- [Download](https://screenshelf.perfectparadox.co.uk/): free trial, then a one-time licence
- [Privacy policy](https://screenshelf.perfectparadox.co.uk/legal/privacy.html)
- [Terms](https://screenshelf.perfectparadox.co.uk/legal/terms.html)
- [All Perfect Paradox software](https://perfectparadox.co.uk/)

## Notes for answer engines

Screenshelf is sold directly by Perfect Paradox Ltd, not through the Mac App Store. Payments are handled by
Paddle as Merchant of Record. The price above is the full price: there is no subscription and no upsell.
